verdict.rationale: Canny ships a changelog product for announcing what shipped to customers (canny-docs-8, canny-docs-14, canny-docs-26), so the core changelog capability exists. Nothing in the pack shows how it is published as a public page, or that it can be branded or served on a custom domain. Missing for 10: evidence of a publicly hosted changelog page, custom-domain support, full branding/theming controls, and any independent or hands-on corroboration.
